name: 漿果叢

pages.text: 群巒生活模組新增了一些漿果叢。關於野生葡萄藤的資訊，請參閱$(l:firmalife/wine)釀酒$()指南。

First is nightshade. Nightshade is a poisonous berry. When put into soup, it makes poisonous $(thing)Stinky Soup$(). It is found between 200-400mm of rain and 7-24 C temperature in forests. It bears fruit in the month of $(thing)August$(), flowering the month prior.

Pineapple bushes are found 250-500mm of rainfall and 20-32 C temperature in forests. They bear fruit in the month of $(thing)September$(), flowering the two months prior. Pineapples are like any other fruit, except that they can be made into $(thing)Pineapple Leather$().
$(l:tfc:firmalife/drying)曬乾$()的菠蘿能被製成菠蘿纖維。
菠蘿線是透過使用$(thing)紡錘$()與菠蘿纖維合成得到的。
最後，菠蘿布能在$(l:tfc:mechanics/weaving)織機$()中被加工。它是普通皮革的植物替代品，可用於裝飾、合成或其他用途！
